jobs.title: Design codex
jobs.objective: Design RFC 0043 V1.5 deltas closing D102 follow-up findings: (a) crash-recovery persistence gap in src/striatum/daemon_pg/repo_local_migration.py (transactional rollback or checkpointed resume); (b) CLI escape path closure — audit src/striatum/cli/ for any silent SQLite fallback bypassing STRIATUM_DAEMON_REQUIRED, default-flip to mandatory; (c) wire `daemon migrate-repo-local` subparser in src/striatum/cli/parser.py + dispatch in src/striatum/cli/dispatch.py; (d) end-to-end test asserting exit code 12 on unmigrated repo. Backward-compat: additive Postgres schema changes only; `--keep-sqlite-readonly` tombstone must keep working.

jobs.title: Synth codex
jobs.objective: Reconcile the three designs into ONE concrete plan for RFC 0043 V1.5: (a) crash-recovery shape (transactional vs checkpointed) with named function + isolation level; (b) CLI escape path closure — exact daemon_required.py default change + audit list of bypass paths; (c) exact parser + dispatch wiring lines for `daemon migrate-repo-local`; (d) exact end-to-end pytest path for exit code 12.

jobs.title: Review design claude ergonomics_dx
